mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 49 degrees at Verona Community Park. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

Regarding city news, a school bus driver was arrested for O W I on Thursday, October 15, after reports of dangerous driving. Also, residents can use the city's interactive map to verify their zoning district, and updated polling locations are available for the upcoming elections.
Today, catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market at the capitol square and live music at Paddy Mac's.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of erratic driving while transporting students near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace.
You can treat yourself to today's flavor, O R E O R E E S E S Cheesecake, when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
